name: @latticekit/example-idle
description: IDLE — a gallery exhibit. Cost curves and buy-max in closed form, then fourteen hours of offline in one frame.
$comment: Seven of nine, and the subject is `sim`: `costOfNext`, `bulkCost`, `maxBuyable` and one `advanceOver` that resolves fourteen hours in a single step rather than fourteen hours of ticks. `persist` is absent deliberately — the absence is a button, not a save — and `audio` for the AudioContext-gesture reason every other exhibit gives.
